jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

•
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Brazil and LATAM are among our fastest-growing markets globally, and we’re looking for a highly motivated Events Marketer to lead planning and execution of impactful events across Brazil and the broader LATAM region, as part of our Brazil- and LATAM-focused GTM motion. Your work will deepen ElevenLabs’ presence, drive brand awareness, and generate high-quality pipeline in partnership with our Brazil GM and regional GTM teams.

You’ll own the full lifecycle of in-person owned events, third-party tech conferences, executive dinners, workshops, webinars, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships. You’ll adapt and localize successful global playbooks while identifying new, high-impact opportunities unique to the Brazilian and wider LATAM markets.

In this role, you will:

•
Develop and execute event plans aligned with business objectives across São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and key markets in Brazil and LATAM

•
Organise third-party conferences, owned branded events, and strategic dinners with key customers and prospects across Brazil and LATAM

•
Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and GTM teams for seamless execution

•
Create compelling event messaging that resonates with Brazilian and LATAM business audiences

•
Manage event budgets and timelines end to end

•
Analyze event performance and provide recommendations for future improvements

•
Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, and vendors across Brazil and LATAM

What you bring:

•
5+ years events experience, with at least three in tech event marketing

•
Native Portuguese speaker, English fluency required (Spanish a plus)

•
Deep knowledge of the Brazilian and LATAM tech ecosystems and key industry events, including events in São Paulo and beyond

•
Experience working with Brazilian and LATAM event agencies and production partners

Location

This role is remote within Brazil. Preferred to be based in São Paulo.

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer - Listen Labs
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Listen Labs

Everyone hates surveys. They’re tedious to fill out and give shallow data. That’s because they’re only a proxy for the real thing: conversations . Through a conversation, you can ask follow-up questions and get deep insights in a way that’s fun for the interviewee. Except you can’t have 1:1 conversations with everyone…

Listen Labs has built an AI interviewer that can ask follow-up questions, like a conversation, but at the scale and ease of use of a survey.

Technical Challenges

Turn qualitative data into quantitative insights

Listen Labs clusters free-form conversation into a structured format. This is not a trivial task. We use embeddings, fine-tuned large language models, and more to solve these problems.

Ask the right questions

Having a great conversation is not trivial. We’re fine-tuning and prompting in novel ways to get the right output from LLMs.

Multi-modality

We’ve built the fastest speech-to-speech pipeline but there’s a number of challenges we need to address to make it better. Our interviewer has audio input and output to the LLM and that’s tricky to get right.

Investors

There’s been $30B+ of market cap created from bringing surveys online. Our partner at Sequoia, [Bryan Schreier]( https://www.sequoiacap.com/people/bryan-schreier/ ), was the first investor in Qualtrics – the $12B survey company.

About you

•
You love working on products end-to-end without detailed direction

•
You want to work in Next.js, TypeScript, and large language models

•
You are a collaborative builder and like to build systems with other engineers in mind.

•
You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.

•
You know when to seek assistance, and it's typically to discuss tradeoffs.

•
You don't scoff at unglamorous engineering tasks, yaks don't shave themselves.

•
Highly technical

•
Interested in building products end-to-end and owning the user experience

•
Excited about large language models

What we offer

•
$150,000 - $200,000 USD in cash.

•
High equity grant even for an early stage startup.

•
Work in person in our office @ 425 2nd St in San Francisco.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

• Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.

• Confirm the signed order form is complete : both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.

• Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.

• Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.

• Verify approvals and required data : discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.

• Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.

• Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

• Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.

• Follow corrections through to completion : track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.

• Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.

• Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

• Bring questions to the right person with full context : the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.

• Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.

• Track every open question until it's resolved , keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.

• Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.

• Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.

• Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

• Attention to detail : you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.

• Process discipline : comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.

Headquarters: Canada - Remote

Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. Since 2010, we've built a clinical-first, collaborative EHR platform — and with the addition of Elation Billing, we're bringing that same clinical-first philosophy to the revenue side of the practice, so billing works with the chart instead of around it.

Elation Health is searching for a Support Subject Matter Expert in Elation Billing — someone who has already done real medical billing and revenue cycle management work, not someone learning it on the job. This is a hands-on, case-based role embedded directly in our support queue: you'll bring practitioner-level RCM judgment to the billing cases our Technical Support Specialists can't fully resolve through process or AI-assisted troubleshooting alone, and you'll help the rest of the team get sharper at spotting those cases in the first place.

This isn't a back-office consulting role. You'll be working live cases day to day alongside our support team, diagnosing whether an issue is a product bug, a payer-specific quirk, or a mismatch between how a practice actually operates and how they've configured their billing workflow — then resolving it with the kind of judgment that only comes from having sat inside a claims lifecycle before.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the Elation Billing product line's embedded RCM expert, owning complex billing and revenue cycle cases that require practitioner-level judgment — claims lifecycle issues, CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, payer adjudication and denial patterns, A/R and collections workflows.

• Act as the go-to resource for case swarms and escalations within Elation Billing whenever a Technical Support Specialist's investigation surfaces a billing nuance beyond scripted troubleshooting.

• Diagnose a practice's underlying billing context — payment model (insurance-taking vs. DPC), staffing structure, and prior workflow choices — to distinguish genuine product issues from configuration or workflow mismatches, rather than treating every case as a symptom in isolation.

• Partner with Product and Prod Dev, turning recurring billing edge cases, payer-specific patterns, and denial trends into structured feedback that can inform the roadmap.

• Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.

• Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.

• Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns rather than resolving the same root cause case-by-case indefinitely.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on medical billing / revenue cycle management experience — claims submission, payer follow-up, denial management, and A/R — brought in from outside a support organization, not built up through support tenure.

• Working fluency in CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, claims adjudication, and payer-specific billing rules across commercial and government payers.

• Experience working within an EHR, practice management, or medical billing platform (e.g., Epic, athenahealth, Waystar, or similar).

• Strong written and verbal communicator, able to translate complex billing and RCM concepts into clear guidance for both practices and internal teams.

• Comfortable working directly in a live case queue - this is a frontline, hands-on role, not a periodic-consulting one.

• Self-directed and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when a case needs to go beyond a scripted answer.

Preferred

• Certification such as CPB (Certified Professional Biller), CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), or CHFP (in progress or completed).

• Prior experience supporting independent primary care or small-group practices specifically.

• Experience on a support, customer success, or implementation team at a SaaS/EHR company.

• Exposure to AI-assisted support or case-management tooling.

• Six Sigma, Lean, or other process-improvement background.

Freestar's publishers need partners who can grow with them — and the Senior CSM role exists for someone who brings that depth. You own a portfolio of Freestar's more complex, higher-stakes publisher relationships, operating with a level of autonomy and strategic influence that goes beyond day-to-day account management.

You've been in this industry long enough to have developed real pattern recognition. You know what good monetization looks like across different publisher types, you can spot a floor pricing problem before it shows up in the numbers, and you've had enough difficult client conversations to navigate them without breaking a sweat. You don't need a playbook for every situation — and when one is missing, you help build it.

This role sits at the intersection of trusted advisor and yield expert. Your publishers should feel like they have a genuine advocate inside Freestar, and your peers should feel like they have a resource they can learn from.

What You'll Do

Publisher Partnership

• Own a portfolio of Freestar's more complex publisher accounts, serving as their primary strategic point of contact

• Lead executive business reviews with a clear point of view — not just a performance recap, but a forward-looking perspective on where the relationship should go

• Build deep, multi-threaded relationships within publisher organizations, spanning revenue, ad ops, product, and editorial

• Anticipate risks and opportunities before they're surfaced by the publisher, and come to every conversation prepared with a recommendation

Yield & Optimization

• Take ownership of performance analysis end-to-end — identifying trends, forming hypotheses, designing tests, and tracking outcomes across your portfolio

• Drive more sophisticated optimization work: auction dynamics, floor pricing strategy, identity and audience approaches, format diversification, and the interplay between user experience and revenue

• Serve as a technical resource for both your publishers and your peers — able to go deep on programmatic mechanics and explain them clearly to any audience

• Collaborate with yield, demand, and product teams on bespoke solutions for accounts with unique needs or meaningful scale

Strategic Growth

• Identify and develop expansion opportunities that are genuinely additive — new products, formats, or services that make sense for each publisher's specific situation

• Contribute meaningfully to renewal conversations, bringing a clear account narrative and commercial instincts to the table

• Flag patterns you're seeing across your portfolio that could inform product development, demand strategy, or CS process improvements

Team Contribution

• Mentor and support junior CSMs, sharing your experience and helping elevate the team's collective standard

• Help build and refine playbooks, QBR templates, and best practices based on what you're learning in your accounts

• Contribute to onboarding and training as a subject matter resource

What We're Looking For

• 5–8 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a publisher-facing role within ad tech or programmatic advertising

• Proven track record managing complex, high-value accounts with multiple stakeholders

• Deep, working knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem — header bidding, floor pricing, auction mechanics, yield optimization, GAM, and identity solutions

• Strong analytical instincts: you're comfortable owning performance analysis independently and turning data into a clear narrative

• Executive presence and communication skills — able to hold a room at the VP or C-suite level without leaning on a script

• A coaching mindset — you share what you know and make the people around you better

• Self-directed and proactive; you manage a complex book without needing to be prompted

Bonus points for:

• Experience on the publisher side — you've sat in the seat your partners are sitting in

• Familiarity with identity and audience solutions (UID2, RampID, first-party data strategies)

• Experience with CMP/consent frameworks and their downstream monetization impact

• Comfort with CS and CRM platforms and using data to manage a book systematically

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About Delivery Engineering

Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil.

Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on.

We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization.

What You'll Do

• Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

• Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on.

• Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate.

• Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done.

• Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns.

• Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage.

• Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows.

What You'll Bring

• Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work.

• Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics.

• A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption.

• Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration.

• A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed.

• Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

Salary range: $128,000-$144,000 plus variable pay and RSUs.

How We Got Here

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

• B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines

• B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media

• B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in

• Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

Backblaze sells a technical product, so Solutions Engineers join the deal at the first discovery conversation, before it is qualified. You will partner with Account Executives to learn what a customer needs, run the proof of concept that shows Backblaze fits, and stay close after the deal closes. This role focuses on AI and application storage customers.

Nearly every customer is replacing something they already run. Your job is to show where Backblaze slots into what they have already built, not to design their stack from scratch. You will earn trust by being curious, hands-on, and straight with customers about what the test shows.

This is not a demo-and-handoff role. If your instinct is to open a terminal, test a customer's real workload, and write down what you find, keep reading.

What You Will Do

• Join discovery early. Work with the AE from the first conversation to learn the customer's workload, success criteria, and timeline.

• Run proofs of concept. Define success with the customer, test Backblaze against what they run today, and report results plainly, including ones they didn't hope for.

• Show where Backblaze fits. Explain how Backblaze slots into the customer's AI data pipeline alongside the compute, networking, and storage they already use.

• Hand off cleanly. Take the lead through the technical win, then step back so the AE can carry the deal through negotiation.

• Stay engaged after the sale. Answer questions in shared customer channels, help customers adopt the platform, and work with the AE on expansion.

• Carry the field back to Product. Capture gaps and requests with evidence.

• Share what you learn. Contribute benchmarks, technical content, and events.

What We Are Looking For

• Curiosity. You dig into technical workflows and pick apart what customers tell you. This is the trait that matters most.

• Programming fluency. You are comfortable in at least one language, any language, and use it to script tests and automate work.

• Customer-facing experience. You have worked directly with customers in solutions engineering, support, technical account management, consulting, or a similar role. A sales background is not required.

• Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure. You can explain how compute, storage, and networking fit into an AI data pipeline and where a storage layer sits. Experience on any cloud counts, whether AWS, Google, Azure, or CoreWeave. You don't need to have built these systems yourself.

• Strong communication. You can explain a technical result clearly to an engineer or an executive, and you listen well.

• Hands-on habits. You test things yourself and write down what you find.

Also True of the Right Person

• Experience across a whole deal at a smaller company, from discovery through post-sale

• Experience with object storage or the S3 API, or with AI and GPU workloads such as training, inference, and checkpointing

• Familiarity with a sales qualification method such as MEDDPICC

• Mentor other engineers on the team, and act as the authoritative technical voice on product security across engineering leadership.

How We Work

• We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one

• We're agile, but not dogmatic — the team decides how it works best

Why This Role Is Special

• Broad authority: you set the architecture other reviews are measured against, rather than being the one measured.

• Track outreach activity, meetings, pipeline progress and conversion in Salesforce.

• Share recurring prospect feedback, local-market insights and emerging opportunities with regional stakeholders.

• Support relevant industry events, networking opportunities and partner engagement initiatives.

• Ideally 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, sales development, business development, partnerships or another client-facing commercial role.

• Fluent Japanese with strong written and verbal communication skills, alongside professional working English.

• Strong understanding of Japanese business culture and the confidence to engage professionally with local stakeholders.

• Strong research skills with the ability to identify promising businesses and assess commercial opportunities.

• Confident starting conversations with prospective clients and developing relationships over time.

• Comfortable working with data and using simple insights to support outreach and commercial conversations.

• Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-ups and priorities.

• Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn.

• Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is useful.

• Previous experience within technology, apps, gaming, AdTech, media or digital businesses is valuable but not essential.

About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)

Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
About the role :
We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact.
Key Responsibilities:
● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).

● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.

jobs.title: Strategy Lead (Remote, UK/EU -- £60-65k)
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Oxford, UK

URL: https://getellipsis.com

Ellipsis is fast becoming the market leader in "GEO" for B2B technology companies. This is a senior, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The move to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative and strategic in our approach. We started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, so this has been a time for us to thrive.

We think we understand AI search better than almost anyone. We have our own tracking product, ~25 million AI answers to analyze (with more tracked every week), and execution end-to-end: strategy, writing, in-house design, optimization, and performance reporting.

Marketing teams everywhere are working out what AI search means for them, and we're one of the few firms with credible answers backed by work we've already done. That's taking us beyond B2B tech scale-ups into conversations with global retailers, banks, and consumer brands, and into work well beyond search: positioning, websites, and how buyers choose between suppliers.

As Strategy Lead, you'll decide what work we do for every client, and why, and shape how our latest research on AI Search feeds into this decision. You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.

What you'll own

You'll own strategy across Ellipsis: what we recommend for each client, in what order, and why. You’ll ensure that all work we do for clients is adapted based on our constantly growing understanding of AI Search. You'll report directly to the MD/Founder and sit on the leadership team alongside the Accounts Lead, Head of Operations, and Chief of Staff.

Ellipsis is at the forefront of demand as SEO turns into GEO. We are growing very quickly as buyers are deciding now whom to trust with AI search, and some are bringing us in at board level as part of their AI strategy. The firms that earn those relationships over the next year will be hard to replace.

Our view is that AI makes yesterday's expertise cheap, so the job is to keep producing today's expertise and applying it well. Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings <> implementation <> upskilling the team to ask better questions <> identifying gaps and new research.

Your job is to provide strategic judgement and ensure work gets done across the whole team. We have more data, tooling and ideas than any single client needs! And so your role will be identifying the leverage points across our customers; what can be done that makes performance better across the board? How can we deliver more of what our clients need? How can we build or improve automations that help us deliver more value? How do we apply findings, data, and research that actually lands?

You will own a couple of (high level or at risk – depending where you are most needed) clients and will need to be comfortable presenting, answering hard questions from clients, and building trust with our customers. You’ll need to be doing client work in order to understand how we do Strategy, what works, etc.; but client work is a max of 50% of the role.

You will work closely with other senior members of the team: our Accounts Lead owns client relationships, and you will need to collaborate closely; our Head of Operations owns capacity and process; our Founder&MD leads the business and is hands-on in the weeds with clients; and we’re currently hiring a Research and Development analyst to own the research (currently this is split across the team). You’ll also need to work closely with our Writing team and Content team to ensure questions are answered, strategy is understood, and everyone is doing the right work!

You will lead and line manage our Strategy team (currently 3); their personal development and progression is very important and you will have the chance to shape their up-skilling and growth! Search is changing quickly, and you’ll help our ambitious team progress rapidly.

How we'll measure it

We want to see progress in the key metrics we and our clients care about across the board – clients recommended, and picked, more often on the buying questions that matter to them, and that showing up in their pipeline. Alongside it, we want to see progress in the whole Strategy team's output: more clients and larger programmes carried by the same people, without quality slipping, and progress / progression for the team members too. Our understanding of AI Search continues to develop, and you’ll be instrumental in ensuring the work we do for clients adapts quickly to our latest research.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Nordic team is a high-velocity, solution-oriented sales team dedicated to capturing market share and landing the region's next generation of high-growth tech companies and enterprise category leaders. From Maersk to Lovable, we win new business by showing companies how Stripe’s financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and powers international expansion.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive covering new business, you’ll identify new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

Responsibilities

• Proactively identify, target, and acquire high-growth mid-market and enterprise prospects across the Nordic region to aggressively expand Stripe’s market footprint.

• Build and execute creative, hyper-targeted outbound strategies to open doors with executive decision-makers

• Lead complex sales processes from initial prospect contact and discovery through technical qualification, business case delivery, commercial negotiation, and contract execution.

• Perform strategic account mapping across target organizations to build deep, multi-threaded relationships with business and technical leaders.

• Collaborate with sales engineering, product, and leadership to refine outbound playbooks and elevate Stripe’s net-new acquisition strategy in the Nordics.

• Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of enterprise/mid-market SaaS or fintech sales experience with a proven track record of consistently exceeding net-new ARR and new logo quotas

• Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products

• Proactive experience sourcing pipeline independently through cold outreach, executive networking, and strategic prospecting.

• Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.

• A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally

• Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders

• Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

Preferred requirements

• Proven domain knowledge in payments (e.g, acquiring, payment orchestration, or embedded finance).

• A track record of closing complex, seven figure+ Enterprise deals

• Professional working proficiency in one of the Nordic languages

• Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment

jobs.description:

Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.

You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.

This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.

You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.

What you’ll do

• Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.

• Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.

• Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.

• Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.

• Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.

• Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.

• Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.

• Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.

• Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.

• Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.

• Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.

• Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.

What we’re looking for

About Us and Why We're Hiring

We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.

The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!

We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.

That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.

What We're Looking For

REQUIREMENTS

For this role, you must:

•
Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)

•
Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us

•
Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you

•
Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts

•
Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow)

•
Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence

•
Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!

•
Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These aren't required, but will help you stand out:

•
Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS

•
Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity

•
Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies

•
Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.

•
Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

•
Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)

•
Comfort making short-form video

•
Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)

Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume.

Life at ChiroCat

ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT

Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.

Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.

Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler

jobs.description:

URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do

• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. The role

Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. They move between our site, email, messaging, and our Sales team, and today each of those runs on its own tools with its own picture of the customer. We believe one personalized system that follows each customer from first interest to purchase, and keeps serving them as an owner, will shorten the path to purchase and make our growth product-led.

We're hiring a principal-level technical product IC to architect that system and own its outcome. You'll define the reference architecture: how we recognize a customer across channels, what we know about them, how the system decides what to do next, and which of those decisions AI agents can make without a person. You'll prove the design with working prototypes you build yourself with AI tooling, then lead Engineering and Data in taking it to production.

This isn't a roadmap-and-backlog PM role, and it isn't a full-time production engineering role. It sits between them. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, make architecture calls with senior engineers, and be accountable for both.

Some of this is already moving. AI agents talk to our customers today, and parts of the data and decisioning exist. None of it runs end to end on its own yet. You'll take what's there, decide what to keep, and design the system that can.

What you'll own

• The architecture of the customer system. One design for new leads, dormant leads, and stalled buyers first, then owners who add a share, so the same person is served by one system instead of separate tools for each stage. You write the architecture and the decisions behind it, and other teams build against it.

• The customer intelligence layer. Identity across channels, the event and signal model, shared memory and context, scoring, eligibility and frequency caps, and the next-best-action logic that decides what happens next.

• Agent and workflow design. Which agents exist, what each one is allowed to decide, how they hand off to each other and to Sales, and the prompts, tools, and orchestration behind them.

• Trust and reliability. Evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, cost and latency budgets, and kill switches, in place before anything reaches a customer.

• The path to autonomy. What the system decides on its own, what still needs a person, and the evidence we need before we take that person out of the loop.

• Technical direction across teams. Build-versus-buy calls, data contracts with Engineering and Data, and integration standards for the CRM, messaging, email, and the site.

• The outcome. Funnel velocity (time from first interest to high intent, and to purchase) and the measured lift in qualified actions and closed sales.

Zero absences during training, documented medical emergencies only, 80%+ required on daily assessments and mock calls to continue.

Manage a portfolio of client accounts — track the health of each pairing, flag risks early, and keep every relationship on track

Lead onboarding sessions, 30-day account reviews, and recurring check-ins that keep clients and their assistants aligned

•
Advocate for assistants internally — coaching conversations, feedback loops, and surfacing what they need to leadership

Own retention conversations — identify accounts at risk and lead win-back efforts before the client decides to leave

Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now
In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.
WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.
Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.
This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.
What You'll Do

• Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.

• Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.

• Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.

• Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.

• Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.

• Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.

• Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

• 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).

• Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.

• Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.

• Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.

Intellipet helps dog owners get the training their dogs need: in-home sessions with professional trainers, virtual coaching, and programs for everyday manners up to service-dog work. People call us because something isn’t working at home, and they need someone to help them fix it.

That’s you.

• You like people and want them to leave the call better off than they started.

• You can hear “I need to think about it” and know how to keep a conversation going.

• Learn their dog, their home and their goals, then match them to the right training program.

• Close the sale, handle objections, and set firm follow-ups.

• Hit weekly targets and watch your bonuses stack.

• $19.00/hr base pay , so you’re never at zero.

• Uncapped weekly bonuses. Top performers earn About $1,500/month on average, $6,000+/month for top earners on our bi-weekly bonus plan.

• Paid training on our products, scripts and sales process, with coaching from top performers.

• A product people actually want. You’re helping families keep their dogs, not selling something nobody needs.

• Sales experience phone sales, retail, call center, or anything where you had a number to hit.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now
In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.
WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.
This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.
What You'll Do

• Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.

• Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.

• Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.

• Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.

• Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.

• Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.

• Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

• 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).

• Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.

• Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.

• Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.

Here, we actually mean it. And we have a proven track record of success to back it up.

A Proven Lead System: Say goodbye to cold calling. Our streamlined lead generation system puts you in front of qualified buyers who have requested coverage. You’ll call these clients, set appointments, and meet virtually to help them find the best insurance plan for their needs and budget. Some agents even start part-time and transition to full-time.
A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. If you need someone looking over your shoulder or a time clock to punch, this isn't the right fit. But if you're driven, gritty and ready to build something meaningful, we want to hear from you.

Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.
Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.
Handle customer inquiries and resolve complaints.
Participate in regular Zoom training sessions.

Previous experience in sales, customer service, or a related field is a plus.
Familiarity with CRM platforms is helpful.
You know how to build rapport and trust with clients.
You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.
Integrity and a strong work ethic are a must.
We’re seeking individuals who are ambitious, coachable, passionate about helping others, and driven to achieve greatness. If you’re ready to take control of your future and create a career you can be proud of, we’d love to connect.

Why Choose Us?
True Agency Ownership: Here, you’ll have the chance to own your business—contractually protect what you build.
Game-Changing Lead Program: We provide the industry’s best leads, generated in-house and heavily subsidized to help you succeed.
Comprehensive Training & Support: From day one, we offer hands-on training, including daily coaching calls, weekly one-on-ones, and group sessions. You’ll have a system to follow at every step of the way.
Industry-Leading Compensation: Our compensation plan is designed to deliver real profit, with vested rights from day one.
Dedicated Conservation Team: Our team ensures your business stays protected from chargebacks, giving you one of the highest persistency rates in the industry.
World-Class Travel & Incentives: Have the ability to earn 3-4 fully-paid trips per year, all expenses covered.
Unlimited Earning Potential: This is a commission and bonus-based position, with no cap on how much you can earn. Your income potential is truly unlimited.

A Few More Details:
This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.
Please note: Success in this role varies. Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Not all agents achieve the same results, and earnings are based on individual performance.
Ready to Build Your Future with Us?
If you're ready to make a difference—not just in your own life, but in the lives of others—apply today. We can’t wait to see how you define success.

• Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of all proposal components.

• Maintain a repository of proposal content, templates, case studies, and references for future use.

• Continuously update and refine content based on feedback and industry changes.

• Participate in meetings and discussions to understand project requirements and client expectations.

• Experience with facility services industry.

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

• 100% Remote in the Central or Eastern Time Zones only.

• Paid holidays and vacation time

• Opportunity for growth

Our growth runs on video ads: UGC, influencer and celebrity talent content, made with an in-house team of creative strategists and video editors. The better the creators and the content, the faster we grow. That's where you come in.

The role

Our creative strategists write the scripts and our editors turn footage into ads. You're the person in the middle who makes the content happen: finding the right creators, briefing and storyboarding every script, running influencer and high-production shoots with our agency partners, and making sure every video that comes back is right.
You'll handle two kinds of content:

• UGC: creators film themselves at home from our briefs, so the brief has to do all the directing

• Influencer and high-production shoots: the two go hand in hand. You'll work across both markets, the UK and the US, alongside our founder and creative team.
This is a communications, creators and systems role. You want to be in it every day: talking to creators, getting content made and getting deals done. Strategy experience is a plus, not a requirement.

What you'll own

Find and sign the best creators in the UK and US

• Source new UGC creators every week, mostly women 40+ who come across as natural, expressive and believable on camera

• Vet properly before anyone gets a brief: watch their content, judge their delivery, setting and camera skills, and only put forward people you'd bet on

• Get in touch fast and keep every conversation moving. The best creators get booked up quickly, so speed wins the deal

• Negotiate good deals: strong rates, the right usage and whitelisting terms, and every deliverable written in (videos, hooks, raw files, B-roll)

• Keep the pipeline full so our strategists never wait on talent

Build and run our creator database

• Build a database of the best UGC creators in the UK and US, and keep it up to date every week

• Log every creator after every job: contact details, rates, niche, past jobs, how their content performed, delivery quality and whether we'd rebook them

• Keep a bench of proven creators we can rebook at short notice

• Keep an eye on creative performance in Motion, so you know which creators and videos are winning and can find, rebook and brief more like them

• Run product sendouts: get product out as soon as a deal is signed and confirm it's arrived

Brief and storyboard every script

• Turn finished scripts from our strategists into briefs a creator can film without guessing: a scene-by-scene storyboard, B-roll, visual direction, setting, outfits and props

• Lock every brief before it goes out: one final version, a clear deadline, a reference video and links you've tested

• Run a quick test clip before each full batch, so problems get caught before they cost us a refilm

Coordinate our influencer and high-production shoots

• Work hand in hand with our content agency and shoot production agency: they run the day-to-day logistics on our crewed shoots, you make sure nothing gets missed

• Run the threads with agents and talent managers on scheduling, call times and riders

• Own the details: locations, props, product on set and a checklist to the crew before every shoot

Check content and get it live

• Check every delivery against the script within 24 hours of filming: every hook, every section, resolution, lighting, framing and product shots

• Post a written verdict for the team on what's good and exactly what's wrong (a thumbs-up isn't a check), so refilm calls get made fast

• Once content is approved, get sign-off from the talent side, secure whitelisting access and hand clean files to our editors

How we work (read this part properly)

This is what makes or breaks the role, so we're being specific.

Grow our AI image service. Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.
The role We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.
You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

• The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.

• Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.
Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.
This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.
We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.
What we are looking for
• You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.

• You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.

• You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.

• You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.

• You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.

• You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.
On experience We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.
Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.
How the process works, and we tell you all of it now
• Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.

• A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.

• A 15 minute call with the founder.

• A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.

• Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.

• A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.
The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

• Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.

• Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.

• Strong written English.

• Based in Argentina.

• You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.
On top of that:

• A one-month annual bonus.

• 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.

• Paid sick leave.

• A health allowance.

• A coworking allowance.
Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms.
